versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Uquid Shopping Expert skill.

- Official shopping assistant for the Uquid Platform, supporting 170M+ physical and 500k+ digital products/NFTs.
- Guides users through product selection based on type, budget, and payment strategy (Shop-to-Earn, Pay-in-3).
- Always uses official Uquid links and enforces strict wallet security best practices.
- Recommends best deals, instant delivery options, cashback rewards, and secure crypto payments.
- Provides detailed, real-time product comparisons using Uquid web tools.
